verdict.rationale: The quickstart says you can chat with the model through llama.cpp's Web UI by opening a browser to http://localhost:8080/. The CLI reference lists Web UI options for server mode, and a community user praises the "web server with chat" UX, so a built-in graphical chat interface clearly ships. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Web UI's chat features (conversation history, settings, multimodal uploads within the UI), detail beyond single-line mentions in the docs.
